title: Formal smoothness at the contracted prime descends along a field extension
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-weil-pbc-smooth-at-prime-field-extension-descent, the contracted prime is formally smooth: Algebra.IsSmoothAt k (PrimeSpectrum.comap (TensorProduct.includeRight : S →ₐ[k] K ⊗[k] S).toRingHom qK).asIdeal.

source.place: Lemma 00TG, faithful-flat descent of cotangent conditions

proof.text: Apply the faithful-flat descent argument of Stacks Algebra, Lemma 00TG, to the local map induced by S → K ⊗[k] S at qK. Finite type over the field k gives finite presentation; the field extension makes the base-change map faithfully flat, and localization gives a faithfully flat local map. Cotangent-complex homology and Kähler differentials commute with this flat base change. Smoothness at qK gives vanishing of the localized first cotangent homology and finite projectivity of localized differentials; faithful-flat descent gives the same conditions over the contracted local ring. The naive cotangent criterion then yields formal smoothness at the contracted prime.
